# Supplemental dependency notice

`react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8` omits its license file from the npm package. The MIT notice is preserved from the upstream repository at [8ca9ba5ea52de03308fe8ced94f7b159a44d28ff](https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/8ca9ba5ea52de03308fe8ced94f7b159a44d28ff/LICENSE). The UI notice build uses this file only for that exact installed package version; future missing notices continue to fail the build.
